pay.title: Pay
pay.requestHint: A Lightning invoice, or a bitcoin: link that carries one.
pay.requestRequired: Paste or scan a payment request.
pay.scanHelp: Take or choose a picture of the QR code. The picture stays in this browser.
pay.scanFailed: No QR code was found in that picture. Try a sharper picture, or paste the text.
pay.fromLink: Opened from a link: check the details before paying.
pay.noLimits: No spending limits are set for this node.
pay.retrySame: The answer did not arrive. Trying again sends the same payment, never a second one.
pay.stillRunning: This payment is still running. Check again in a moment.
pay.preimageHelp: Shown here only. Copy it now if you need it: the payment history does not show it.
pay.failed: The payment failed. No money was sent.
pay.unknown: The result of this payment is not known yet. It may still complete.
pay.unknownHelp: Do not pay this invoice again. Lightning Pilot keeps asking the node and settles the payment when the node knows the result. The payment page shows what the node reports now.
pay.showPayment: Show this payment as the node sees it
pay.duplicate: I understand that a payment to this destination for this amount was recently made or is still pending.
pay.duplicateWarning: A payment to this destination for this amount was recently made or is still pending.
pay.stepUpReason: Payments above your step-up threshold need your password.
pay.stepUpFee: The maximum fee exceeds your usual cap. This exception needs your password.
pay.feeOverride: The maximum fee exceeds your usual cap. This exception requires your password.
pay.optionalAmount: Amount in sat (only for invoices without an amount)
pay.invalidAmount: Enter a whole number of satoshis.
pay.handoff.onchain: This is an on-chain address. On-chain payments are sent from the on-chain screen.
pay.handoff.node: This is a node address, not something to pay. You can connect to it as a peer.
pay.handoff.unsupported: This kind of payment request (BOLT12 offer, Lightning address or LNURL) is not supported in this release.
pay.handoff.unknown: This is not a payment request this app recognises. Paste a Lightning invoice.
errors.decode.malformed: This payment request is damaged or incomplete. Copy it again.
errors.decode.unknown_prefix: This payment request is for a currency or network this node does not use.
errors.decode.invalid_amount: The amount in this payment request is not valid.
errors.decode.invalid_signature: The signature of this invoice does not match: it may have been changed.
errors.decode.missing_field: This invoice lacks a required part.
errors.decode.unknown_feature: This invoice needs a feature this app does not know, so it cannot be paid safely.
errors.decode.not_minimal: This invoice is not written in the standard form, so it is refused.
errors.decode.wrong_network: This payment request is for another network than this node's.
errors.decode.wrong_chain: This invoice is for the other chain. Paying it from this node is refused.
errors.decode.inconsistent: The parts of this payment link disagree (for example two different amounts).
errors.decode.unsupported: This kind of payment request is not supported in this release.
